text: dsh-plugin-memory 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的长期记忆插件：它把 Markdown 记忆库接入会话上下文与技能系统，在会话启动时注入灵魂档案、记忆协议、目录和近期活动。主要功能包括会话记忆开关、记忆页访问记录、记忆健康面板、可交互关系图谱，以及搜索、整理、检查和迁移记忆的命令行工具。适合希望让 DSH 跨会话保留用户偏好、项目事实和决策的人。默认使用本地记忆目录，不需要额外 API 密钥；可配置目录，并可选择自动提交 git 历史。

This DSH web plugin stores memories in Markdown and injects selected files at startup. It adds a memory skill and per-session controls, plus a panel for store health and page relationships. Its CLI searches, checks, and migrates the local store. No API key is needed; git auto-commit is optional.
想让 DSH 在新会话里继续记得我之前说过的偏好和决定。
有没有办法把长期记忆保存在普通 Markdown 文件里？
我想在设置页里调整记忆目录或暂时关闭记忆注入。
让 DSH 启动时自动读入我的人格设定和记忆索引。
我想查看哪些记忆页面很久没访问，顺便检查记忆库健康状况。
能不能把记忆页面之间的链接和共同标签画成图？
我需要搜索、整理并打包迁移本地的 Markdown 记忆库。
How can I keep preferences and project facts available across DSH sessions?
I want to inspect and maintain a portable Markdown memory store from the command line.
dsh-plugin-memory 的功能「启动时注入记忆」：将配置指定的灵魂档案、记忆文件和索引装入 DSH 会话上下文，并按字符预算截断。会话开关和活动门控可阻止注入。
dsh-plugin-memory 的功能「内嵌记忆技能」：向 DSH 注册 memory 技能，指导代理执行记忆初始化、记录、回忆、整理与遗忘流程。
dsh-plugin-memory 的功能「会话记忆开关」：使用 /memory on、off 或 status 查看和切换当前会话记忆，也可设置工作区默认状态。
dsh-plugin-memory 的功能「记忆图谱」：面板从图谱接口获取记忆页关系，可依据页面链接与共同标签展示节点和连接。
dsh-plugin-memory 的功能「健康面板」：只读接口汇总页面数量、访问新鲜度、近期活动和检查结果，供设置界面查看。
dsh-plugin-memory 的功能「CLI 记忆维护」：dsh-memory 提供搜索、检查、索引同步、状态查看以及 pack/unpack 迁移等命令。
dsh-plugin-memory 的功能「自动记录页面访问」：插件从实际注入的上下文中识别记忆页，并更新已有 frontmatter 的 last_access 日期。
dsh-plugin-memory 的功能「人格档案编辑」：设置面板读取并保存 SOUL.md 的受管理档案区，可编辑代理称呼、用户称呼和简短人格描述。

dsh-plugin-memory README · dsh-plugin-memory：> Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — a portable markdown memory store with a soul, injected at every session start.

**macOS · Windows · Linux** · Node ≥ 18 · DSH `^0.2.1-rc.5` · MIT

dsh-plugin-memory README · What it does：A Cordis plugin that gives DSH agents **persistent, cross-session, migratable memory**: plain markdown + git (the *LLM Wiki* pattern), a `SOUL.md` persona, and a boot block **auto-injected through runtime context** — a hard guarantee, not a hope that the model decides to call a skill.
dsh-plugin-memory README · Quickstart：```sh

dsh-plugin-memory README · 1. install：dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-plugin-memory
```

Or install from a **plugin index**: enable *Custom plugin indexes* under **Plugins → Experimental**, open **Discover → Add index source**, paste

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LittleBlackTong/dsh-plugin-memory/main/docs/market/index.json
```

then install **Memory** from the list. (A JSON index in the official format, served from this repo.)

dsh-plugin-memory README · 1. install：2. **Restart the app.** In the first session the agent starts the **soul-forging** conversation itself (or skip it: **Settings → Memory → Basic soul**, one save).
3. **Verify:** `dsh-memory doctor`, or open **Settings → Memory** for the health dashboard and hot settings.

dsh-plugin-memory README · Features：- **Remembering across sessions** — boot block = SOUL + MEMORY protocol + `index.md` + recent activity, with a per-file budget so the index tail is not truncated first.
- **A soul, not just storage** — SOUL + BOOTSTRAP forging; a quick-setup card writes a managed block; persona names are read from SOUL, never hard-coded.
- **You stay in control** — per-session switch (chip / `/memory on|off` / panel) and `disabledWorkspaces` defaults.
- **A companion** — digest nudge, proactive recall, weekly growth recap, context-sensitive tone; shared speech floor with other proactive plugins.
- **Portable** — plain markdown + git, `pack`/`unpack`, optional auto-commit.
- **Memory graph** — interactive 3D sphere: rotate / zoom / drag nodes, search-to-focus, hover or click to light up neighbours; select a node → **Reveal in Finder** or **Copy path**.
- **Health tools** — dashboard, `checkup`, `lint`, `doctor`, automatic `last_access` stamping.
- **Zero build, bilingual panel, hot-editable config.**

dsh-plugin-memory README · Screenshots：**Basic soul (quick forging)** — set the agent's name, what it calls you and a baseline persona in one save; the next session uses it, no restart. Chat-forged souls are echoed back from `SOUL.md`.

**Memory graph (3D)** — a live projection of the store: rotate / wheel-zoom / drag nodes to arrange, search-to-focus (the camera flies to the hit), hover or click to light up the neighbourhood. Select a node to **Reveal in Finder** or **Copy path**; double-click empty space to reset.

dsh-plugin-memory README · Screenshots：**Settings panel** — sixteen settings apply immediately (per-session switch, boot gates, recall cadence, tone, disabled workspaces…). The health dashboard and the graph sit right below.

dsh-plugin-memory README · Cross-platform：**macOS, Windows and Linux are supported.** Path settings expand `~`, `~\`, `%USERPROFILE%` and `$HOME`; CRLF files are parsed as LF and **written back with their own newline style**; *Reveal in Finder* maps to `open -R` (macOS), `explorer /select,` (Windows, space-safe argv) and `xdg-open` (Linux); `disabledWorkspaces` matching is case-insensitive on Windows. Details: [docs/CONFIGURATION.md](docs/CONFIGURATION.md).

dsh-plugin-memory README · Configuration：Sixteen hot keys edit live under **Settings → Memory**. The full table, boot-budget rules and composition overrides are in [docs/CONFIGURATION.md](docs/CONFIGURATION.md).

dsh-plugin-memory README · CLI：```sh
dsh-memory init [dir]        # scaffold the store
dsh-memory search <query>    # full-text search
dsh-memory checkup           # one prioritised health report
dsh-memory doctor            # environment check-up

Store resolution: `$MEMORY_DIR` → `./.memory` → `~/.memory`.

dsh-plugin-memory README · Docs：[Configuration](docs/CONFIGURATION.md) · [Design notes](docs/DESIGN.md) · [Migration](docs/MIGRATION.md) · [Proactive protocol](docs/PROACTIVE-PROTOCOL.md) · [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Security](SECURITY.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

dsh-plugin-memory README · FAQ：**Does it burn tokens every request?** No — runtime context is deduplicated by projection; an unchanged payload is injected once.
**File skill vs plugin?** The file skill is a soft guarantee (only its blurb is injected); this plugin is a hard one. They coexist (the file skill ranks higher); remove any hand-written persona to avoid double injection.
**Where should the store live?** `~/.memory` by default; point `memoryDir` inside a project for isolation.

dsh-plugin-memory README · Development：```sh
git clone https://github.com/LittleBlackTong/dsh-plugin-memory.git
cd dsh-plugin-memory
node scripts/memory.mjs --self-test   # smoke test, nothing to install
node --test                          # full suite

Zero build: `lib/` is runtime code as-is. CI runs both commands.
